name: R.P.M. ~Hitomi no Naka no Omoide~
source:
A popular robot contest "GIRLS" is being held for the 10th time on the TV. Main character attends the same school club as robot girls participating in the contest. The hot summer of his dreams begins now.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
热门机器人竞赛“GIRLS”即将在电视上迎来第十届大赛。主人公与参加比赛的机器人少女们同属一个学校社团。他梦想中的火热夏日，就此拉开帷幕。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
